question.prompt: Segment \(AB\) is 6 cm long and parallel to the projection plane. The projection rays are perpendicular to the projection plane. What is the length of the orthographic projection of \(AB\)? (Unit: cm)

solutions.explanation: When a segment is parallel to the projection plane, its orthographic projection is parallel and equal in length to the original segment, so its length remains 6 cm.
solutions.title: Length preservation
